o.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian خسته (xasta). Cognate with Turkish hasta. The sense "fan, devotee" is a semantic loan from Russian боле́льщик (bolélʹščik).

From Mongolic, ultimately from Middle Mongol 合班.
Cognate with Tuvan хаван (xavan), Kazakh қабан (qaban), Kyrgyz каман (kaman), Northern Altai кабан (kaban), Southern Altai каман (kaman), Nogai кабан (kaban), Tatar кабан (qaban), Kumyk къабан (qaban), Karachay-Balkar къабан (qaban), Turkish kaban (dialectal), Uzbek qobon, etc.
